normal: an installed selected processor receives only the original event/slot or Work artifact version and declared purpose, reads bounded bytes, and reports source-bound text
a paid external tool publishes two immutable image versions from its own call and cold recovery reads the original effect
an environment file captured by descriptor is delivered from its verified digest even after the origin is replaced
faults: foreign plugin, stale generation, unrelated operation, missing selection, outside offset, different digest and unregistered method are denied
late ASR after forget cannot publish a transcript or command; unsubscribed processor receives no payload
an unsupported vision profile and a foreign image handle retain the original successful tool effect without another invocation or model purchase
